definition: To make people feel more relaxed when they first meet.
thai: ละลายพฤติกรรม; ทำให้บรรยากาศผ่อนคลาย
example: Mina told a silly joke to break the ice at the new club.

definition: To reveal a secret, often by accident.
thai: เผลอเปิดเผยความลับ
example: Please do not spill the beans about the surprise party.

definition: Feeling slightly ill or low in energy.
thai: รู้สึกไม่ค่อยสบาย
example: I am staying home because I feel under the weather.

definition: Something that is very easy to do.
thai: ง่ายมาก; หมู ๆ
example: The first puzzle looked difficult, but it was a piece of cake.

definition: Very rarely.
thai: นาน ๆ ครั้ง
example: Our busy coach takes a day off once in a blue moon.

definition: To begin studying seriously.
thai: ตั้งใจอ่านหนังสือ
example: With exams next week, it is time to hit the books.

idiom: Cost an arm and a leg
definition: To be extremely expensive.
thai: แพงหูฉี่
example: That golden skateboard costs an arm and a leg.

idiom: Let the cat out of the bag
definition: To reveal a secret, usually without meaning to.
thai: เผลอเผยความลับ
example: Kai let the cat out of the bag when he mentioned the hidden cake.

definition: Something that seems bad at first but leads to a good result.
thai: เรื่องร้ายที่กลายเป็นดี
example: Missing the bus was a blessing in disguise because I met my future teammate.

definition: To face a difficult or unpleasant situation bravely.
thai: กัดฟันเผชิญปัญหา
example: I had to bite the bullet and apologize for the broken window.

definition: To stop working for now.
thai: หยุดทำงานวันนี้
example: After fixing the robot, the team decided to call it a day.

definition: Extremely happy or excited.
thai: มีความสุขมาก
example: Nok was on cloud nine after her team won the quiz.

definition: To tease someone by making them believe something untrue as a joke.
thai: อำเล่น; หยอกล้อ
example: I said the principal was a secret magician, but I was only pulling your leg.

idiom: The ball is in your court
definition: It is your turn or responsibility to make the next decision.
thai: ถึงตาคุณตัดสินใจ
example: I sent the group two plans, so now the ball is in your court.

definition: To avoid saying what you really mean.
thai: พูดอ้อมค้อม
example: Stop beating around the bush and tell us who ate the last cookie.

definition: Doing something late is better than not doing it at all.
thai: มาช้าดีกว่าไม่มา
example: Tao finally returned the library book; better late than never.

definition: To become difficult to control.
thai: บานปลาย; ควบคุมไม่ได้
example: The balloon fight got out of hand when the teacher joined in.

definition: To watch or look after someone or something.
thai: คอยดูแล; จับตาดู
example: Could you keep an eye on my model rocket while I get tape?

definition: To miss an opportunity by acting too late.
thai: พลาดโอกาส
example: We missed the boat on the early tickets, so the concert was sold out.

definition: Said when someone appears just after being mentioned.
thai: พูดถึงก็มาเลย
example: Speak of the devil—there is Ploy at the classroom door.

definition: To work or study late into the night.
thai: ทำงานหรืออ่านหนังสือจนดึก
example: We burned the midnight oil to finish our science display.

definition: To do something too quickly or cheaply by skipping important steps.
thai: ลดขั้นตอนจนคุณภาพเสีย
example: If we cut corners on the bridge model, it might collapse.

definition: To stay hopeful and keep trying through a hard time.
thai: อดทนไว้นะ; สู้ต่อไป
example: Hang in there; the last lap is almost over.

definition: In trouble because of something you have done.
thai: กำลังเดือดร้อน; มีปัญหา
example: Max was in hot water after the class gecko escaped.

idiom: Kill two birds with one stone
definition: To achieve two things with one action.
thai: ทำครั้งเดียวได้ประโยชน์สองอย่าง
example: I listened to an English podcast on the bus and killed two birds with one stone.

definition: To have just enough money to pay for basic needs.
thai: หาเงินให้พอใช้จ่าย
example: The family sold homemade snacks to make ends meet.

definition: Unexpectedly and without warning.
thai: อย่างไม่คาดคิด
example: Out of the blue, a parrot landed on the school bus.

definition: To agree with someone.
thai: เห็นตรงกัน
example: The twins did not see eye to eye on the band's name.

idiom: Take it with a grain of salt
definition: To avoid believing something completely because it may not be true.
thai: ฟังหูไว้หู; อย่าเพิ่งเชื่อทั้งหมด
example: Take the rumor about a dragon in the gym with a grain of salt.

definition: During both good times and difficult times.
thai: ไม่ว่าจะสุขหรือทุกข์
example: Our friends stayed together through thick and thin.

definition: A cheerful way to wish someone good luck before a performance.
thai: ขอให้โชคดี (ก่อนการแสดง)
example: Break a leg, Niran! Your school play opens tonight.

definition: Something that will probably never happen.
thai: ไม่มีทางเกิดขึ้น
example: Dad says he will learn to juggle when pigs fly.

idiom: Give someone a piece of your mind
definition: To tell someone firmly that you are annoyed with them.
thai: พูดตำหนิอย่างตรงไปตรงมา
example: The librarian gave us a piece of her mind for racing between the shelves.
